adjudicated.jp: 「ふう」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Whew."
comments: Fuu, the wind, the pretense. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The relieved exhalation is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: テーブルの上に、メモが置かれていた。
adjudicated.en: On the table was laid a memo.
adjudicated.assessment: The memo lying on the table is accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: 『夕食あるかも』
adjudicated.en: 『There's dinner perhaps』
comments: Slight passive-aggressive, and centered as well. That latter one is so suspect. This should be Youko/hallucination, but it could be read as Yusa's mom, who keeps feeding him. Hell, for all we know it IS. The dinners are suspiciously never seen, and it's just odd that Taichi would want to hang around Youko for lengths of time. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The tentative note that dinner may be available is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 「わーい、行く行くー」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Weeee, I'm coming I'm comiiing!"
comments: Curiously, "weeee" has precisely 4 e's. -GHStuffingCommentsWithUselessInformation
adjudicated.assessment: The playful excitement and declaration that he is coming are preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 自分で用意しないですんだ。
adjudicated.en: I don't need to make it myself then.
comments: That means he doesn't need to make food himself. ...which he never shows to be really capable of until like Sendback. The point is that he seems unable to call for delivery food. -GHStuffingCommentsWithUselessInformationThatDoesn'tTurnIntoUsefulIsHard
adjudicated.assessment: The relief that he need not prepare dinner himself is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 三分で着替えると、いそいそと彼女の家に向かうのだった。
adjudicated.en: I changed my clothes in three minutes then cheerfully headed towards her house.
adjudicated.assessment: Changing in three minutes and eagerly heading to her house are accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: 夕食は、おいしゅうございました。
adjudicated.en: 'Twas a most pleasingly delicious dinner.
comments: Formal and old-fashioned. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The deliberately polite statement that dinner was delicious is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 独特の輝きが、室内を照らす。
adjudicated.en: A very peculiar radiance illuminates the room.
adjudicated.assessment: The distinctive glow illuminating the room is accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: 蝋燭が好きだった。
adjudicated.en: I loved candles.
comments: See CCE0001. Hmmm. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The narrator's fondness for candles is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 生の火に、強く惹かれた。
adjudicated.en: Their raw flame captivated me so strongly.
adjudicated.assessment: His strong attraction to the raw flame is accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: こうしてぼんやりと揺らめく炎を見ていると、心が囚われて、いつまでもいつまでもまどろんでいることができた。
adjudicated.en: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.
comments: Specifically doze off, see below. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The flickering flame captivating him into an endless doze is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 以前、それで前髪を焦がしたこともある。
adjudicated.en: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.
adjudicated.assessment: The prior singeing of his bangs is accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: ぶっちゃけ三分前のことだ。
adjudicated.en: OK, that was like three minutes ago.
comments: intentional change of tone. Hum, that's exactly as long as it took him to change. And while it's a joke, the thing above with the candle reads very much like he lost his memory there, didn't it. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The comic admission that it happened three minutes ago is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 「……焦げた……ちくせう」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "...singed... dammit."
adjudicated.assessment: The muttered complaint that it is singed is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 泣きそう。
adjudicated.en: It's to cry.
adjudicated.assessment: The unidiomatic English remains recoverable as feeling ready to cry.

adjudicated.jp: とにかく日記だ。
adjudicated.en: Anyway, to the diary.
adjudicated.assessment: The pivot back to the diary is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 分厚い日記帳を開く。
adjudicated.en: I open the thick diary book.
comments: See CCC4025. Dear dear dear... -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Opening the thick diary is accurately conveyed.

adjudicated.jp: 人生の記録は、大切だよな。
adjudicated.en: The records of life are really precious.
comments: So precious he'll make them the only thing that remains. After all, he can't just burn up his diaries, like he erases his memories, can he. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The value placed on recording one's life is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 仕返しにこの日記上でひどいことをしてやる。
adjudicated.en: As revenge, I'll do mean things to her in this diary.
comments: See CCD2002. She's the one girl he would think twice about even touching. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: His plan to retaliate by doing something cruel to her within the diary is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: ここで赤い薔薇をさした花瓶のアップ。やがて花は根本で折れ、静かに落ちる。
adjudicated.en: Close-up of a vase containing a red rose here. Soon afterwards, cut the flower at its base, that it falls to the ground in silence.
adjudicated.assessment: The flower itself eventually breaks at the base and falls quietly. The English turns this into an instruction for someone to cut it, inventing an agent and changing the action.
adjudicated.remedy: Say that the flower breaks at the base and quietly falls.

highlights.text: cut the flower at its base

adjudicated.jp: 画面が滲んでいき、ホワイトアウト。【完】
adjudicated.en:
The screen blurs, whiteout.
【FIN】
comments: Script feel. Taichi is writing a nukig--- "diary" here after all. This is once more nukige feeling, although the only example I know of is Family of Debauchery anime Episode 1, around the 26th minute mark (that one part is safe, but do notice the rest is pretty hardcore as far as porn goes).  -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The screen blur, whiteout, and ending marker are preserved.

adjudicated.jp: 廊下を歩いていると、美希が掃除をしていた。
adjudicated.en: I was walking down the corridor to find Miki cleaning.
comments: I CITED FAMILY OF DEBAUCHERY IN A SERIOUS ANALYSIS, BEAT THAT ASSHOLES -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Finding the named person cleaning while he walks down the corridor is preserved.

adjudicated.jp: これはゆゆしき問題ですぞ、校長！
adjudicated.en: The tips of my fingers fired towards Miki's ass with the speed of lightning, but merely grazed and couldn't seize the substance.
comments: The three lines are split on the console version anyway since the font is way bigger, so character limit's no issue here. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English translates a separate prefatory comment instead of the bound source line. It entirely omits the exclamation that this is a grave matter addressed to the principal and substitutes an unrelated action.
adjudicated.remedy: Translate the bound source as a mock-formal declaration that this is a grave matter, Principal.

highlights.text: The tips of my fingers fired towards Miki's ass with the speed of lightning, but merely grazed and couldn't seize the substance.

adjudicated.jp: だが弟子が腕をあげたことは、素直に嬉しい。師である俺が抜かれる日は近い。
adjudicated.en: The day when she surpasses I, her mentor, grows near.
adjudicated.assessment: The English omits the statement that he is honestly pleased by his pupil's improvement; 'surpasses I' is also ungrammatical.
adjudicated.remedy: Still, I was genuinely glad my pupil had improved. The day she surpassed her teacher was not far off.

highlights.text: The day when she surpasses I, her mentor, grows near.

adjudicated.jp: 久しぶりに部活に行って、みみ先輩にぱふぱふをした。%Nこの日、俺は一つの到達点に辿り着いた。%N感動、大。
adjudicated.en: I am moved to tears, lots.
comments: Still works in the other sense. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves only the final exclamation and omits the two preceding statements in the same source row.
adjudicated.remedy: After a long absence, I went to the club and got a faceful of Mimi's breasts. That day, I reached a new summit. Deeply moving.

highlights.text: I am moved to tears, lots.

adjudicated.jp: 他にもいろいろとあったが、全体的に良い日だった。
adjudicated.en: And lots of other stuff happened, so overall it was a good day.
comments: It's just there to trick first time readers into thinking the flashback events are simply glossed over rather than nonexistent.. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The summary that various other things happened but the day was good overall is preserved.

comments: Hum, this gets only a 6 in pretentiousness. -GHS

withheld.jp: 今日は学校に行ったのに、授業をさぼった。冬子がやけにつんけんしていた。きっと生理だ。けど生理だからって八つ当たりは良くない。
withheld.en:
Today I went to school, but cut class.
Touko was extremely crabby and mean.
Must be that time of the month.
But it's not nice that she gets eight kinds of angry because of biology.
comments: This just reads like a preschooler's diary. 八つ当たり does just mean "outburst of anger", but it's got a nice number 8 八 right there which is as coincidental as these letters appearing on screen just because I press keys on a keyboard. -GHS

This is a parody of really crappy eroge writing, but because translations of this tone are not exactly consistent ("eye-bleedingly awful" is not a style), going with purple-ish for tone. Several things here will also recur, so it's best for them to be distinctive. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「へへ、嫌がっていても体は正直（略）」
withheld.en:
Me: "Heh heh, no says your voice, but your body
here has evidence (snip)"
comments: Odd, as Touko strikes me as the type that doesn't get wet when "watered"... hahahah realism in dark rape nukige LOL. This is intended to be read as funny the first time through, horrendous on a second reread, but see CCA0030 and most importantly, CCE0001: this is meant literally... when it comes to food.

I take those to mean that what he's truly doing in this scene is simply force-feeding her. Very telling of the kind of "monster" he actually is, and very interesting considering Yusa and her mom. See CCZAS: not the only time he does this with boring standard eroge dialogue. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「あっ、そんなの、いや、やめてやめてっ」
withheld.en: Touko: "Ahh, but that, no, stopit! Stopit!"
comments: This is so bland-nukige there's no saving it. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「駄目だ、もう男がここまで来たら引っ込みがつかないよ！　俺の自慢のライフルでおまえというターゲットにロックオンするしかないんだよ！」
withheld.en:
Me: "Not happening, when a man has come this far
there is no retreat! I can do nothing but
acquire lock on the target that you are with
the rifle of my pride!"
comments: TL Note: that means his penis. If that's Youko, that still means food, since she's the part that can make it. (Yes, Taichi cooks WITH HIS DICK.) See CCA0007. Hum, given some of the currently-recent nukige translations, maybe I should just add random pointless sesquipedalianisms. Because when one thinks "readership target of low-budget rape nukige", that's obvious "people who know what 'cachinnation' means", right. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「いやぁーっ、体は、体はいやぁーっ！！」
withheld.en:
Touko: "NOOOO!!! My body, my body
you caaaaan't!!!"
comments: Romeo Tanaka's beautiful prose, everybody, that even to remove one line is to ruin everything. I wonder where most alleged Tanakafags got that cliche' from... uh, not that I really disagree with it, I mean, this scene is still necessary in like twelve different ways. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「すぐに自分から欲しがるようになるぜぇ」
withheld.en: Me: "Soon you'll come to covet this yourself!"
comments: ...I just wonder how many of those who dress themselves up with that cliche' are so poor at reading comprehension that they never actually noticed that this scene is supposed to read as really really really silly. -GHS
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karu%E1%B9%87%C4%81 This, in particular, will recur. It's one of the few technically non-Christian references. It generally won't work, cough cough cough. -GHS

withheld.en:
Me: "Do I look like I have ears that know how to
hear? Hyaaaa!!!"
comments: TL note: this means he's not listening to her. See CCC3004, where this will have its payoff. For now, compare Sakuraba, who just can't hear right from one hear (though it's psychological). Certainly Taichi has no issues with hallucinations in both cases, see Nanaka, possibly Youko. -GHS
